chose: Give the gate, deploy-production and deploy-sandbox jobs 25 minutes
over: Keep 15 minutes, or drop the gate from the deploy job
because: The gate grew past 4,000 tests and takes 10-13 minutes on CI; under load it crosses 15, and every deploy since b7f2fa48 was cancelled at the job timeout, leaving production behind main. The deploy keeps its own gate as the last check before production.

chose: Every deploy run checks out and gates the branch's tip as it stands when the run starts
over: Skip a run whose push is no longer the tip; or let a push's first attempt deploy its own commit
because: The tip check starved production for hours whenever merges came faster than the gate. A push's-first-attempt exemption relied on run order, which GitHub concurrency does not guarantee (GPT-6.1 Sol round 1). Runs take turns under the concurrency group and main only moves forward, so deploying the tip at run start never rolls back and any later or rerun deploys the newest code (Sol round 2: ship).
